hero.title: OrchID

hero.description: An end-to-end research ecosystem developed at University of Naples Federico II, merging field botany with cutting-edge Computer Vision.

scientific.title: Scientific Context
scientific.content1: The genus Ophrys represents one of the most complex and fascinating cases of pollinator-driven biological evolution. These orchids utilize sexual deception, emitting pheromones and mimicking insect morphology to attract males of specific species.
scientific.content2: This extreme specialization leads to incredible morphological variability and frequent hybridization, making field identification extremely difficult even for expert botanists. The OrchID project was born to provide objective computational tools to support biodiversity monitoring.

vectorSpace.title: Latent Embedding Space
vectorSpace.description: One of the primary goals of this research is constructing a high-dimensional vector space where orchid images are mapped based on their morphological features. This serves as a foundation for similarity search and outlier detection.

ncd.title: Novel Class Discovery (NCD)
ncd.description: Traditional classifiers assume a 'closed world'. Our research focuses on Novel Class Discovery, the model's ability to recognize species never seen during training, identifying 'new' entities in the wild.

experiment6.title: Experiment Analysis: Series 6
experiment6.description: Experiment 6 is the milestone of our current results. After identifying data leakage in previous series, Exp 6 provides a realistic assessment of model generalization.
experiment6.resnetDesc: Our ResNet50 model reached a peak Val F1-Score of 0.905, proving that standard architectures are still highly competitive.
experiment6.vitDesc: DINOv2-Base is our current champion, achieving an average Val F1-Score of 0.914 ± 0.012. It shows exceptional robustness to occlusions and noise in field photos.
